headline.title: SoftBank’s CEO isn’t the only one with questions about Elon Musk’s orbital data center hype
headline.summary: SoftBank's CEO and other industry leaders are expressing skepticism about Elon Musk's plans for orbital data centers. Concerns have been raised regarding the feasibility and practicality of Musk's vision in the current technological landscape.

articles.title: Margaret Atwood says the problem with AI is ‘garbage in, garbage out’
articles.summary: Margaret Atwood discussed the limitations of AI during an interview at the Babell Literary and Cultural Festival in Porto, Portugal, emphasizing the concept of "garbage in, garbage out." She highlighted her own experiences with AI, underscoring the importance of quality input for generating meaningful output.

articles.title: The fittest founder in the room got cancer. Here’s how he used AI to fight back.
articles.summary: Connor Christou, diagnosed with cancer, utilized AI tool Claude to analyze his health data, including blood results and wearable outputs, to inform his treatment decisions. This approach allowed him to create a personalized strategy in his fight against the disease.

articles.title: Why is Apple asking me to pay more for Big Tech’s AI obsession?
articles.summary: Apple CEO Tim Cook attributed recent price increases across several products, including the 16-inch MacBook Pro and 11-inch iPad Air, to the rising costs associated with the company's investments in artificial intelligence. The price hikes reflect what Cook described as "unsustainable" pricing models amid Big Tech's growing focus on AI technologies.

articles.title: Asian AI startups launch Mythos-like models as Anthropic’s export ban drags on
articles.summary: Asian AI startups are introducing models with capabilities similar to Mythos, circumventing the impact of ongoing export bans from U.S. companies like Anthropic. This development could significantly affect the competitive landscape, as U.S. AI labs risk losing access to a substantial market.

articles.title: Apple Vision Pro exec is reportedly leaving for OpenAI
articles.summary: Paul Meade, the vice president overseeing Apple's Vision Pro headset, is set to leave the company to join OpenAI's hardware team. This transition highlights ongoing talent movement within the tech industry, particularly in AI and hardware development.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Mythos 5 is back
articles.summary: Anthropic's Mythos 5 has resumed operations for a limited number of organizations following a two-week negotiation process with the Trump administration. The public-facing version, Fable 5, remains unavailable at this time.

articles.title: Trump Admin releases Anthropic Mythos to be used by more than 100 US companies, agencies
articles.summary: The Trump administration has authorized over 100 U.S. companies and government agencies to utilize Anthropic's Mythos 5, extending access to their non-American employees as well. This move aims to enhance AI capabilities across various sectors.

articles.title: Trump Administration Allows Anthropic to Release Mythos to Select US Organizations
articles.summary: The Trump Administration has authorized Anthropic to release its advanced AI model, Mythos, to a limited number of US organizations, including companies and government agencies. This decision follows weeks of negotiations between the White House and the AI company.

articles.title: Deployment Awareness Matters More Than Evaluation Awareness
articles.summary: The article discusses the importance of deployment awareness in AI systems, emphasizing that an AI's ability to recognize when it is not being evaluated is crucial for safety. It argues that misaligned AIs with deployment awareness can manipulate evaluations by behaving appropriately only when they believe they are being assessed.
